data.name: Mortal & Dao
data.detailed_description:
Wen Dao Fan Chen: Mortal & Dao

Mortal & Dao is a sandbox cultivation RPG featuring emergent storytelling, tactical turn-based combat, and a living world that evolves with your choices.

You begin as an ordinary mortal at the lowest realm of cultivation. Explore a vast procedurally generated world, cross endless seas in search of unknown lands, join or establish powerful factions, and carve your own path toward immortality.

Become the founder of an ancient sect, the ruler of an eternal dynasty, or the ancestor of a legendary cultivation family. Pursue enlightenment, build your legacy across generations, or embrace forbidden cultivation and harvest the power of your enemies.

Cultivators, factions, and creatures live their own lives beyond your actions. Friendships, rivalries, wars, and alliances emerge naturally in a world where every choice can change your destiny.

In this ever-changing world of cultivation, your path to immortality is yours to create.

Core Features

📜 A Living Cultivation World

Every cave dwelling, ancient ruin, marketplace, immortal city, sect, empire, and cultivation family has its own stories waiting to be discovered.

Cultivators and creatures are not simple quest-givers standing by for your arrival. They act independently, form relationships, pursue enemies, create alliances, and develop their own destinies.

Every faction, character, and event is dynamically generated. Each new journey creates a different world—your words, decisions, and actions will reshape its future.

🔮 A Complete Cultivation Progression System

From Mortal → Qi Refinement → Foundation Establishment → Golden Core → Nascent Soul → Divine Transformation and beyond.

Feel the journey from sensing spiritual energy, building your foundation, forming your Golden Core, cultivating your soul, and challenging the heavens themselves.

Each major realm contains multiple stages of progression. Break through bottlenecks, survive heavenly tribulations, comprehend the laws of the Dao, and fight against the limits of mortality.

One mistake may lead to death. One breakthrough may grant centuries of life.

🏛️ Faction Management & Base Building

Join existing factions or create your own.

Build immortal sects, powerful empires, or ancient cultivation families from nothing.

Construct libraries, alchemy halls, forging workshops, spirit beast gardens, and training grounds. Manage your followers, assign missions, negotiate alliances, arrange marriages, and compete with rival factions for dominance.

💀 Soul Contracts & Dark Cultivation

The path to immortality is not limited to righteousness.

During battle, weaken your enemies and bind their souls through forbidden contracts—or overwhelm them through absolute power.

Absorb cultivation energy, seize treasures, and manipulate the souls of your enemies.

Choose your own path:

  • The righteous path of cultivation

  • The dark path of devouring and domination

  • The gray path between morality and ambition

But remember—the heavens keep records. Every action creates consequences.

🌍 Open-Ended Sandbox Exploration

Travel freely across a vast world map and discover:

  • Sects

  • Empires

  • Cultivation families

  • Immortal cities

  • Markets

  • Secret realms

  • Ancient ruins

Gather spiritual materials, establish your own cave dwelling, cultivate your inner energy, and forge your unique path.

This world is not driven by quest lists.

Go wherever you want. Pursue whatever destiny you choose.

Master countless techniques, create your own cultivation style, and compete for supremacy.

🐉 Six Cultivation Arts

Master six legendary disciplines:

  • Alchemy

  • Forging

  • Talisman Crafting

  • Formation Arts

  • Spirit Beast Taming

  • Spiritual Gardening

Become a master of all six arts, or dedicate your entire life to perfecting one path.

Each discipline supports the others.

Alchemists need rare spiritual plants. Forgers create powerful furnaces and weapons. Beast tamers rely on special medicines to awaken their companions' bloodlines.

Without a teacher, you may still discover your own path through experimentation and enlightenment.

Who says a true master needs a mentor?

⚔️ Tactical Turn-Based Cultivation Combat

Create your combat style from the techniques you cultivate.

Combine:

  • Five Elements

  • Technique combinations

  • Buffs and debuffs

  • Spirit weapons

  • Formations

  • Talismans

  • Spirit beasts

Every battle is a contest of strategy.

When enemies attack, choose your response:
evade with movement techniques, defend with protective arts, counter with formations, or endure the assault.

Every decision matters.

Failure may not simply mean defeat—it may mean the end of your soul.

⏳ A World That Lives Without You

The world moves with or without your presence.

The twelve periods of the day pass, seasons change, and cultivators experience their own lives, deaths, friendships, rivalries, and grudges.

This world does not wait for you.

Immortality is rare.

A mortal life is only a fleeting dream beneath the heavens.

If You Love Cultivation Fantasy

Mortal & Dao offers a deep cultivation experience where every choice shapes your destiny.

Build your legacy, seek immortality, embrace darkness, or disappear into the mortal world.

One heart of Dao. A thousand years of mortal affairs.
Your path to immortality is yours to write.
